_readme: A real, filled-in protocol: the cholecystectomy / cholangiocarcinoma
8,491 unique records, 85 batches of 100, 0 failed validations.
It contains NO review data -- only the code system, vocabularies and
platform mapping. Use it as the worked example next to protocol.example.json.

review.title: Cholecystectomy and the risk of cholangiocarcinoma (update of Xiong 2017, PMID 28938668)
review.notes: Title/abstract stage never decides Include. F*/M1 are the Hold pool and land on the platform as Maybe; R1 is excluded but kept for citation chasing.

code_meanings.F1: 题摘明确报告胆管癌结局（全文优先级最高）
code_meanings.F2: 多部位/泛癌队列（CCA 数据常只写在附表）
code_meanings.F3: 题摘无排除理由但信息不足
code_meanings.F5: 仅胆道/肝胆/胰胆合并口径，看不出能否拆出 CCA
code_meanings.F6: 危险因素型、题摘未点名暴露
code_meanings.M1: MR/遗传学研究，转三角验证流
code_meanings.X2: 结局是单一非胆管癌癌种（含仅胆囊癌 GBC）
code_meanings.X3: 无癌症发生结局（预后/诊疗/诊断/机制）
code_meanings.X4: 病例报告·n<10 病例系列·动物·体外
code_meanings.X5: 无比较组/横断面/无时间顺序
code_meanings.X9: 危险因素研究，仅涉与胆囊无关的单一暴露
code_meanings.R1: 综述/Meta/社论/评论/致编辑信（无新数据）

normalize_rules.description: Systematic review / meta-analysis -> R1: R1 means 'no original data of its own', not 'reports no numbers'. A pooled estimate is still a review, and R1 is what carries role:citation-chasing. Definitional, so safe to auto-apply.

audit_exports.name: x2x3_gbc_boundary
audit_exports.description: GBC-only records split between X2 and X3. Both exclude, so inclusion is unaffected and only the PRISMA reason split moves -> human review. Machine normalisation was tried and reverted: keying off `form` would have corrupted 373 correct decisions.
